# Float

Float is a resource management and project planning platform for scheduling teams, managing project capacity, tracking time, and reporting on utilization.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/float/.

## Actions

- **Create Allocation**: Schedule work on a Float project for one or more people, or leave it unassigned, with optional phase, status, notes, and recurrence.
- **Create Project**: Create a Float project with core scheduling and classification fields.
- **Get People Capacity Report** (read-only): Return person-level capacity, scheduled, unscheduled, time-off, billable, and non-billable totals for a required date range.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Retrieve one Float project by ID, optionally including its phases, project tasks, team, expenses, or currency details.
- **Get Project Utilization Report** (read-only): Return project-level scheduled, logged, billable, non-billable, budget, and utilization totals for a required date range, optionally for…
- **List Allocations** (read-only): Find scheduled allocations in Float by project, person, client, phase, project task, date range, billing state, status, or recurrence.
- **List People** (read-only): Find active people on the Float schedule by default, or filter for archived or all people, employee type, department, tags, and related…
- **List Projects** (read-only): Find Float projects by code, client, lifecycle state, billing state, status, or tags, optionally including planning details such as…
- **Update Allocation**: Reschedule or revise selected fields of a Float allocation.
- **Update Project**: Update selected core identity, schedule, lifecycle, and tag fields on a Float project.
